facts.anchor: On Monday, Mom came by the shop to give it a spring makeover. She’d picked up a clear umbrella printed with rainbows, some silk tulips from the thrift store, and a pair of bright yellow rubb
facts.fact: 周一母亲来店里做春季改造：彩虹透明伞、丝质郁金香、明黄雨靴。

facts.anchor: She arranged a few shower toys with a book on natural aphrodisiacs and some colourful tubes of lube. Her sign read: Have fun! Get wet!
facts.fact: 母亲在 Meg 提搬家时总是「big and heavy」地叹气：「This is where I live, Meg.」

facts.anchor: “You could start a business doing this, you know.”
facts.fact: 母亲与 Dale 打招呼「It's nice to see you again」，Dale 却脱口叫出「Debra」——笑容垮掉、环顾茫然。

facts.anchor: “I doubt it.” She reached into the display to adjust the angle of a boot. “People don’t even go into stores anymore.”
facts.fact: Meg 从容自我介绍「I'm your new neighbour, Meg」，并替母亲认领「This is my mom, Vickie」。

facts.anchor: “I’m retired. People would think I’m broke and taking the only work I can get.”
facts.fact: 母亲用怀旧语气提起 rail yard 边的 diner——「我们常去的那些地方」。

facts.anchor: “Screw what people think. If you like doing it, do it. It’s flexible. You could take only the clients you like and only as many as you want.”
facts.fact: Dale 想起儿子说「the toy store」，并自嘲当年以为她卖儿童玩具。

facts.anchor: She waved her hand in dismissal. “I already work at the thrift store.”
facts.fact: Zak 在门口看见父亲迷路，出面解释「Debra retired so now Meg is in this shop」——Zara 却被父亲错认成 Mom。

facts.anchor: “Because I have friends there.” I could see the little hamster in her head running in its wheel, though.
facts.fact: Meg 意识到自己的位置：Georgia 即将回来，她得开始想「自己以后做什么」。
